Arbutus Residences

The Ultimate Move-In Advantage

Up to 5 Months Free Rent on Select Suites.

Sign a new lease by October 31, 2026 to unlock these savings*

*Limited time offer. Subject to specific terms and conditions and may change or be withdrawn without prior notice. The lease must commence on or before October 31, 2026. Contact leasing for details.

Discover the ultimate in luxury living at Arbutus Residences, a premier collection of homes nestled in one of Vancouver’s most desirable and vibrant neighborhoods. Situated near the picturesque Arbutus Greenway, this exclusive residence offers a perfect blend of peaceful suburban living and convenient urban access. Just minutes away from all of life’s daily amenities, Arbutus Residences is ideally located for those seeking a modern, yet tranquil lifestyle.




The architecture of Arbutus Residences reflects the perfect balance of modern luxury and timeless design. These homes boast open-concept layouts that maximize space and natural light, with floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows offering expansive views of Vancouver’s West End, downtown, and the majestic North Shore Mountains. Thoughtfully designed with sleek, durable laminate wood flooring throughout (except bathrooms), each residence offers a spacious and contemporary living experience.

Features:
These residences are equipped with top-of-the-line finishes and energy-efficient features, including:

Energy-Star efficient Blomberg and Samsung kitchen appliances
Stainless-steel Kohler pull-down kitchen sink faucet and fixtures
Stainless-steel double-basin undermount kitchen sink
Modern quartz countertops and tile backsplash
European-style soft close cabinetry with recessed under-cabinet LED lighting
Convenient rotating under-cabinet tray for blind corners
Full-size front-loading Blomberg in-suite washer and dryer
Convenient roller-blinds throughout for privacy and light control
Open-concept living areas designed for maximum space and comfort
Efficient heating system for year-round comfort
Expansive balconies and patios perfect for outdoor relaxation

Building and Amenities:
Arbutus Residences offers a wealth of amenities designed for both convenience and enjoyment:

Fully equipped indoor fitness gymnasium
Children’s play area and a tranquil courtyard for families
Green roof with planters and a community garden for residents to cultivate
BBQ area for social gatherings and outdoor dining
Gated underground parking for security and ease
Stunning views of Vancouver West, downtown, and the North Shore Mountains
A vibrant shopping plaza featuring Safeway, BC Liquor Store, Bank of Montreal, and more
